name: Consistencia de Lengua
algorithm: Tongue Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes tongue rendering and consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Tongue Detección**: The tongue is detected when visible during speech and expressions (tongue protrusions, licking lips, certain phoneme articulations like /l/, /t/, /d/). Tongue shape, color, and surface texture are characterized per frame.

2. **Tongue Anatomy Verificación**: Natural tongues have specific anatomical features: dorsal surface texture (papillae), central groove (median sulcus), smooth ventral surface, characteristic pink-red coloration. The method checks anatomical correctness. AI-generated tongues may show: incorrect color, missing texture, wrong shape, or physically impossible configurations.

3. **Tongue - Fonema Coordination**: Tongue position should correspond to articulated phonemes — visible tongue tip for /l/, /th/, tongue retraction for /k/, /g/. The method checks whether tongue visibility and position correlate correctly with detected speech sounds. Deepfakes may show tongue positions inconsistent with the audio.

4. **Temporal Tongue Estabilidad**: When the tongue is not actively moving (resting in closed mouth, sustained position during speech holds), its appearance should remain stable between frames. The method tracks tongue consistency — AI generation may produce flickering tongue texture or shape changes during supposedly static tongue positions.

5. **Tongue - Teeth - Labio Interaction**: During speech, tongue, teeth, and lips interact in coordinated, anatomically constrained ways. The method checks whether these interactions are physically plausible. Deepfakes may produce impossible interaction states — tongue passing through teeth or occupying impossible positions relative to the oral cavity.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante tongue consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Haliassos, A. et al. (2021). Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach To Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
